question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b44b3d389d5deb211279c6a79a937eceec7f5b2eb18217300cdc8eb1df5027.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

When the mirror is placed vertically to the object, the mirror image will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and** Right** **Hand Side** will interchange their positions while the top and bottom will be same. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f364910396272646823ef01848493bf2bec07353cc1c66e58a181098209ec3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option (2).**
